messages.author: 78adf8c333a0fb37
messages.subject: Authentication for multiple apps
parts:
I'm putting together multiple learnr tutorials deployed on shinyapps.io. I need to be able to control access to the whole set of apps on a user-by-user basis.

I see how, in the standard plan, I can authorize a user to access a tutorial. But I'll have dozens of related related tutorials. It would be impractical to manage the users for each tutorial independently. Instead, I'd like to be able in one operation to authorize/de-authorize a user for a whole set of tutorials.

messages.author: 78adf8c333a0fb37
messages.subject: Re: Authentication for multiple apps
parts:
Thanks! I had only used the magic of the push-button deploy interface and the application authentication dashboard on shinyapps.io as described at https://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/shinyapps.html.

So with addAuthorizedUser() and the related rsconnect functions, I gather that I can do the authentication setup from my local machine without using the dashboard interface on shinyapps.io. Given that I will have lot's of IDs and lots of apps to manage, I will write a little package to manage this and let R on my local machine handle the tedious and intricate task of connecting each user ID to the applications to be authorized for that user. I guess I should have realized that the push-button deploy interface would be written in terms of rsconnect functions and that I can call these directly.
